dataset.inclusion_rule: observed (complete base, C4', C3') at >= 362 consensus positions of the aptamer core; comparisons use the 362 positions observed in every included instance
dataset.fixed_correspondence: Rfam consensus match states observed with complete base atoms in every eligible instance

mapping_check.result: every clustered instance has a match-state residue with coordinates at every shared position

discrepancy.label: Geometric discrepancy
discrepancy.unit: dimensionless (base-centre deviation in A and base rotation in rad, weight 1, divided by n)
discrepancy.definition: D = sqrt(L + O) / n after Kabsch superposition of the n base centres: L = sum of squared base-centre deviations, O = sum of squared base-rotation angles (FR3D standard base frames); fixed correspondence on the n shared Rfam consensus positions
discrepancy.values_layout: row-major upper triangle (i < j) in dataset.instances order; diagonal 0

cut.rule: undo the k - 1 highest merges; height midway between the lowest merge undone and the highest kept

clustering.rationale: Closed vs open S-domain (tetraloop docked into or released from its receptor): 29 vs 21 chains. Largest merge-height gap of the tree (0.311 to 0.463; the next gap is at most 0.025) and the best silhouette for k = 2-6 (0.554); position bootstrap ARI median and 5th percentile 1.00 (fraction >= 0.9: 1.00) and structural-element jackknife minimum ARI 1.00. The groups match an independent geometric readout exactly (tetraloop-receptor P-P distance 5.8-9.9 A in all 29 vs 28-51 A in all 21), and the same split is found in the full 101-chain research set. C4' RMSD gives the identical partition. Group sizes reflect the subset design (stratified selection), not populations. Chosen by the user on 2026-10-19.

floor.definition: 95th percentile of the duplicate pairs (NCS copies, isomorphous re-determinations); smaller differences are not interpretable. Not shown: the 50-chain subset has no duplicate pairs (exact duplicate entries were collapsed when it was selected), so no noise floor exists; the nearest empirical reference is the apo 5 vs 10 mM Mg2+ pair 9OVB/9OVC (discrepancy 0.069, 3.7th percentile)

seriation.input_order: instance identifiers sorted lexicographically before the call
seriation.missing_values: none: the matrix must be complete (missing comparisons are never imputed as maximal differences)

reference.function: treePenalizedPathLength (tree penalty from average linkage, multiple greedy insertion, orientPath)
reference.citation: Aliyev, D. A. & Zirbel, C. L. (2023) Seriation using tree-penalized path length. EJOR 305(2), 617-629. doi:10.1016/j.ejor.2022.06.026

tm.label: TM-score
tm.definition: US-align TM-score with fixed residue correspondence (-mol RNA -I <pair.fasta> -u n), normalised by the n shared positions (symmetric); clustering and the dendrogram use 1 - TM-score
tm.values_layout: row-major upper triangle (i < j) in dataset.instances order; diagonal 1

cut.rule: undo the k - 1 highest merges; height midway between the lowest merge undone and the highest kept

clustering.rationale: TM-score (US-align, fixed correspondence, normalised by the 362 shared positions) at k = 2 gives 42 vs 8: it does not reproduce the closed/open split and separates 8 conformers instead (silhouette 0.35); k = 4 (silhouette 0.44) isolates two four-chain conformer subgroups that have not been interpreted. No position bootstrap or jackknife exists for TM: provisional. Chosen by the user on 2026-10-19.

floor.definition: 95th percentile of the duplicate pairs (NCS copies, isomorphous re-determinations); smaller differences are not interpretable. Not shown: the 50-chain subset has no duplicate pairs (exact duplicate entries were collapsed when it was selected), so no noise floor exists; the nearest empirical reference is the apo 5 vs 10 mM Mg2+ pair 9OVB/9OVC (discrepancy 0.069, 3.7th percentile)

provenance.note: pairwise values copied from the research run; no structural comparison was recomputed
